name: Kymco CV3
engine: 550 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, CVT, two leaning front wheels
intro: Kymco's leaning three-wheel maxi-scooter. A 550 cc twin and a front linkage to keep in good shape.

L: The front tilting linkage has its own bearings and bushings. Check for play before you trust the steering.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
